# Web research

When to use: a unit needs facts gathered from open web sources with citations.

## Steps
1. Form 2-3 search queries from the unit's brief.
2. Read each result; keep only sources with a clear publish date.
3. Write findings as short bullet points, each with a source citation.

## Quality bar
Every claim has at least one citation; no claim is stated without a source.

## Pitfalls
Do not summarise a source you have not actually opened.
